serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Me and {f_botName} quickly moved away so that Richard won’t see her.
I need to answer him and explain the situation.
AbusedTenant: I’m alive!
Little_Richard: Thank God! Where are you?
AbusedTenant: I went back home
AbusedTenant: The unconscious guy you probably went by is DAK 
Little_Richard: Really? I was wondering who he was…
Little_Richard: How did you do it? 
Little_Richard: How did you knock out DAK?
AbusedTenant: I was lucky, I hid behind a corner and hit his head
Little_Richard: Hahaha! 
Little_Richard: What am I supposed to do with him now though?
AbusedTenant: What do you mean?
Little_Richard: I can’t really kill him. Killing someone in self-defense is one thing, but shooting an unconscious man is kinda…
He’s right…
We need to do something or he will just try to kill me again.
Should I go back with the bot and take care of it?
Little_Richard: Wait a minute, I have a plan.
Little_Richard: I will go to his home, destroy all the evidence connecting him to the blog and then will set him up using his illegal firearms. That should keep him in prison for like a few decades.
AbusedTenant: Are you sure you can do it?
Little_Richard: It should be an easy conviction so cops shouldn’t listen to his schizo bullshit about a secret blog
AbusedTenant: Makes sense. I’m counting on you and thanks for your help!
Little_Richard: No problem! After all, you are in my squad and I need to take care of you
It seems like DAK is done for.
Little Richard appears to be some kind of master of intrigue with how fast he came up with his setup plan.
Bot: As you are no longer in danger, I can reduce my surveillance on you a little. 
You: How about you stop it altogether…
Bot: I can’t do that! What if something bad happens to you?
You: Suit yourself then…
I’m not happy about being watched by {f_botName}, but I can't really argue against it because her help was really welcome this time around. She saved my life.
Let’s for now just go along with her overprotection.
